name: antika geode mod
description: Gameplay toggles for Geometry Dash: negative hitboxes, accurate/TRIE hitboxes, negative mode, noclip, force ice, force platformer, force classic, don't move camera, force game mode in classic and all modes in platformer (Ship, Ball, UFO, Wave, Robot, Spider, Swing).

ending-dialog-key.name: Show Ending Dialog
ending-dialog-key.description: Press this to show the story ending dialog again at any time. The key can be changed in Geode's keybind settings.

disable.name: Story Mode
disable.description: When enabled, level 149188646 is played automatically on the main menu and an ending dialog appears after you beat it.

neghit.name: Negative Hitboxes
neghit.description: Set every object's size to -1 and turn off the level's "Fix Negative Scale" option, so every hitbox becomes negative (objects are safe, the empty space is deadly).

negative.name: Negative
negative.description: Invert the world: upside-down play and photo-negative colors on top of Negative Hitboxes. Can only be enabled when Negative Hitboxes is on.

accurate.name: Accurate Hitboxes
accurate.description: Make spike and saw hitboxes accurate: you die on the real shape of the object (triangle for spikes, circle for saws) instead of the rough rectangle.

truehit.name: TRUE Hitboxes
truehit.description: Make EVERY object's hitbox accurate: the accurate shape check is applied to every hazard, not just spikes and saws. Can only be enabled when Accurate Hitboxes is on.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Spikes can't touch you and blocks are passable: you can fly through everything and never die.

force-ice.name: Force Ice
force-ice.description: Every block becomes an ice block in platformer mode, so all surfaces are slippery.

force-platformer.name: Force Platformer
force-platformer.description: Play classic levels in platformer mode.

force-classic.name: Force Classic
force-classic.description: Play platformer levels in classic mode. Overrides Force Platformer when both are on.

make-3d.name: Make Everything 3D
make-3d.description: Apply the famous 3D shader look to every level: Radial Blur (size -0.50, intensity 500000, ref channel 1234, empty-only), Bulge of 0.25 and the shader covering layers B5 to Max.

no-camera-move.name: Don't Move Camera
no-camera-move.description: Freeze the camera on the level's starting view instead of following the player: it never pans, zooms or reacts to the level's camera triggers.

all-modes-platformer.name: All Modes in Platformer
all-modes-platformer.description: Play platformer levels as any game mode (Ship, Ball, UFO, Wave, Robot, Spider or Swing) instead of only Cube.

platformer-mode.name: Platformer Mode
platformer-mode.description: Which mode to play as in platformer levels when All Modes in Platformer is on.

force-gamemode.name: Force Game Mode
force-gamemode.description: Play classic levels as any game mode (Ship, Ball, UFO, Wave, Robot, Spider or Swing) instead of only Cube. Pick the mode below.

gamemode.name: Classic Game Mode
gamemode.description: Which mode to play as in classic levels when Force Game Mode is on.
